title: logbox configuration
description: Content of the box logbox pins below a wrapped command. Either bare rows or an object carrying a title.

row.title: row
row.description: One rendered line. The first cell is left aligned, the last one right aligned, connected by a dot leader. A single cell renders as a plain label.

rows.title: rows
rows.description: All lines of the box, top to bottom.

$schema.description: Reference to this schema; ignored at runtime. A relative path works too.

title.description: Title rendered into the top border. Defaults to "logbox".
